usage: music-tagger lyrics [-h] [--lookup] [--fetch] [--embed] [--dry-run]
                           [--replace] [--track N] [--disc D] [--lyrics-id ID]
                           [--log LOG | --no-log]
                           path

Inspect lyrics for an album, look up LRCLIB candidates, or write sidecar
lyrics. With no mode, only inspects: no network, no writes.

positional arguments:
  path            Album directory.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --lookup        Search LRCLIB and show each candidate with its evidence.
                  Uses the network; writes nothing.
  --fetch         Choose LRCLIB lyrics and save them as <audio-stem>.lrc or
                  .txt beside each track.
  --embed         Write each track's sidecar lyrics into its tags: .lrc if
                  present, else .txt. A backup for when sidecars are lost. No
                  network.
  --dry-run       With --fetch or --embed, show what would be written.
  --replace       With --fetch, replace existing lyrics and remove a stale
                  sidecar of the other type. With --embed, replace a different
                  value in the lyric tag.
  --track N       Only track number N.
  --disc D        Disc number D, with --track, on multi-disc albums.
  --lyrics-id ID  Use LRCLIB record ID for the --track track instead of
                  searching. Needs --track.
  --log LOG       Append changes to this log file (default: $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG,
                  else ~/Projects/music-tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log        Do not write the change log.
